one.title: Farmers market map
one.prompt: A weekend farmers market map for a small coastal town. Shoppers filter stalls by what's in season, save a shortlist, and see which stalls take cards.

two.title: Pottery studio board
two.prompt: A pottery studio booking board where members reserve wheels, see which glazes are in stock, and join a weekend firing.

three.title: Tool library
three.prompt: A neighborhood tool library. Neighbors list drills and ladders, request to borrow them, and check what's back by Sunday.

four.title: Espresso journal
four.prompt: An espresso tasting journal. Log beans, score sweetness and finish, and compare the last five shots side by side.
